text:
deploy-bot: scheduling model enable: halley-7b-qa in catalog for 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z (change window 02:00-04:00 UTC). Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Fallback order: [halley-7b-v1, titan-1-2, default-ggml]. No global pin. Release notes draft: https://confluence.redwood/rel/halley-7b-qa :eyes:
priya: quick Q — metrics to watch during canary? should we add a safety gate for cost increase? :thinking_face:
liam: p99 latency, 5m error-rate, and per-token cost. Suggest rollback triggers: error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency > 1200ms for 5m. Also alert on sudden token usage > 2x baseline.
alexa: EU region has stricter fallback rules — if fallback to titan-1-2 happens we need to pin traffic there for 30m for compliance tracking. Can we add region-specific pin in the rollout?
marco: canary hosts (canary-gpu-pool) are up and drained tests passed. Autoscale policy tuned: min=2, max=10 for the window.
priya: thanks marco. I'll add the EU pin step to rollout_policy under region_overrides. Draft release notes below:
```
Release: halley-7b-qa enable
Canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% (monitoring at each step)
Fallback priority: halley-7b-v1, titan-1-2, default-ggml
Rollback thresholds: error-rate > 1% (5m), p99 latency > 1200ms (5m), token-cost > 200% baseline (5m)
Region override: EU -> pin to titan-1-2 on fallback for 30m
Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC
Owners: @priya, @liam, @marco, oncall: @sara
```
liam: add a post-deploy smoke test for tokenization differences and hallucination regression on our critical prompt set. If hallucination score increases by >3% vs baseline, hold and rollback.
sara: oncall acked, will watch dashboards and keep pager ready. If we hit rollback triggers I'll coordinate immediate pin back to halley-7b-v1 and notify infra. :thumbsup:
priya: deploy command ready. running dry-run now, will cut over if dry-run clean.
```
# example deploy command
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/catalog/enable" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"halley-7b-qa","canary_pct":5,"canary_steps":[5,25,100],"fallback":["halley-7b-v1","titan-1-2","default-ggml"],"region_overrides":{"eu":{"on_fallback_pin":"titan-1-2","pin_duration_minutes":30}}}'
```
marco: dry-run logs look clean, no OOMs. starting canary at scheduled time. :shipit:
deploy-bot: started rollout at 2333334460, canary 5% active. Monitoring hooks enabled: alerts -> #eng-alerts, logs -> datadog/catalog/halley-7b-qa.
priya: watching metrics. will update after 15m check. :eyes:
sara: oncall will escalate if any of the rollback conditions hit. good luck team! :rocket:
